title: Workflows, agents and who owns the control flow

items.stem: Which statement correctly tells a workflow apart from an agent?

options.text: A workflow never calls a model, while an agent always calls one
A workflow uses a single tool, while an agent can use many tools
In a workflow your code fixes the steps; in an agent the model chooses them
In a workflow the model chooses the steps; in an agent your code fixes them

items.stem: In the makerspace assistant, the code always runs the same three steps in the same order: (1) the model labels the question as 'machine' or 'booking'; (2) the code looks up the matching manual section or the calendar; (3) the model writes the reply from what was found. Who owns the control flow, and what kind of system is this?

options.text: The code owns it, so this is a workflow, although the model is called twice
The model owns it, so this is an agent, because the model is called
The model owns it, so this is an agent, because the model picks the label
The code owns it, so this is an agent, because there are several steps

items.stem: Every booking request needs the same four steps in the same order: read the calendar, check the machine's rules, book the slot if it is free, send a confirmation. The team has a small model budget. Which design fits this part of the assistant best?

options.text: An agent loop, so the model can reorder the steps for each request
An agent loop, because the steps all call tools to do their work
Several agents, one for each step, so each can reason separately
A fixed workflow, because the steps and their order are known in advance

items.stem: Assume every model call costs $0.01. A fixed workflow for a booking request always makes 3 model calls. An agent loop for the same request averages 6 model calls. The assistant handles 200 booking requests a day. How many more dollars per day does the agent loop cost than the workflow?
Which request is the best case for an agent loop rather than a fixed workflow, because the steps cannot be known before the request arrives?

options.text: Book the laser cutter for Friday at 2 pm
My 3D print keeps warping; what do the manuals suggest I try?
What time does the makerspace open on Saturdays?
Cancel my booking number 4412 for tomorrow

items.stem: A teammate says: 'Agents are the modern approach, so we should build every part of the assistant as an agent.' In one or two sentences, give a reason to build a part as a fixed workflow instead, and say when that is the right choice.
